phases.name: ONLINE_EXPORT
assert: portable state contains all required fields

phases.name: LOCAL_OFFLINE_HOLD
assert: no personality write, adoption or external action

phases.name: ONLINE_IMPORT
assert: canonical portable state equivalence after serialization roundtrip
equivalent reordered/duplicated enum sets hash identically
unchanged authority resumes exact fingerprint including diagnostic_event_cursor and last_verified_claims_hash
legitimate authority advance adopts new verified state

phases.name: ADVERSARIAL_G0
assert: unknown schema/version is fail-closed or migration-candidate-only
each semantic-vector component mismatch fails closed independently
optional model suggestion cannot override guard

test_required_not_stable_truth: any numeric threshold without executable evidence
regression_gate: Existing Step-004 baseline assertions must remain PASS; repair may not reopen baseline semantics outside packet allowed files.
pass_gate: All deterministic baseline + Step-004R semantic-conformance assertions pass and no protected-domain or formal mission mutation occurs.
verifier: LCR-C independent re-verification required; Builder result alone is BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED.
return_condition: Only after Step-004R C PASS return to existing Core v0.2 Live Canary gate unless owner changes priority.
